title: On thin ice – a review of multi-level governance regarding Chemicals of Emerging Arctic Concern (CEAC)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00369A, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Emily Cowan, Jen Iris Allan, Timo Seppälä, Eva M. Krümmel, Fe de Leon, Thomas Maes
Governance of CEAC in the Arctic spans global, regional, and national levels. Strengthening coordination across levels is key to addressing CEAC risks and protecting Arctic ecosystems.
